title: Made a little spaceship shooter: pew pew through space
author: National_Flower7240
selftext:
Been messing around and built a spaceship shooting game. Simple, arcadey, and honestly pretty satisfying.  
Still tweaking it, but flying around and shooting stuff already feels fun. There's something timeless about a good space shooter…

comments.author: That1guy4226
comments.body: Those controls look a bit too snappy for me but it looks good over all. Great job

replies.author: That1guy4226
replies.body: Have you considered adding a strafeing/dodge sideways mechanic?

replies.author: National_Flower7240
replies.body:
Great suggestion! I’ve actually been thinking about it. A dodge mechanic could make combat feel much more dynamic. I’ll prototype it and see how it fits the gameplay

comments.author: MakingAGamee
comments.body:
Copy n paste this it'll fix movement. 

The turns and movement of player ships are way to fast, sporadic. It should be smooth and simpler. Fix player ship turning/rotations to be more natural with motion.

comments.body:

comments.body: it made me my eyes hurt beyond your comprehension

comments.author: BRaiNDED_Games
comments.body:
Overall looks nice, but 2 critiques would be the motion (mentioned already) and everything in the environment is cranked to 11 in terms of intensity. The stars and planets and everything should have much more variety in the way of contrast, brightness, sharpness etc. 

Also the FOV is creating a disorienting fish eye effect.

Keep tweaking though it has potential!

comments.author: oVerde
comments.body:
Stop! ✋

Dont make me believe in it then sink a month of hours and tokens trying it and not getting even close to the posted results.

comments.author: proximalcoast
comments.body: Hell yeah brother! I’m working on a Descent inspired one. Space so cool. So cool. It’s so pretty. So pretty 🤩

replies.author: National_Flower7240
replies.body: Hell yeah! Descent is an absolute classic. Getting that 6DOF movement feeling right must be a fun challenge. Are you using AI mostly for the coding or the visuals? Would love to see a demo when you have one!

replies.author: proximalcoast
replies.body:
Yeah, killing my self with it for sure. The lab course is roughly done, base pilot from my initial run, ran 10  pilots through the lab course to find problems in the feel at least academically… but yeah. Long way to go.

My plan is all AI everything, the future is now, old man!

comments.author: homiej420
comments.body:
Hope you had fun! 

Thats one of the biggest most important factors going into game dev as someone new you should make sure happens, have fun experimenting!

replies.author: National_Flower7240
replies.body: 100% agreed! The experimenting part is definitely the best bit. Just tweaking things until the game feels right is so satisfying. Thanks for the kind words!
